bio: A cool concept that varies over the course of the week, attracting guests all day long. A cosy breakfast is served Thursday to Saturday; at lunchtime on Thursdays and Fridays there is an affordable dish of the day. From Wednesday to Saturday, the evening meal is all about sharing. The interesting menu offers a surprise Chef's Choice (only available if ordered by the whole table), or you can choose the delicious dishes yourself and share them. Incidentally, the cooking tends towards the vegetarian. The food is as unfussy as the relaxed and lively atmosphere that reigns in the restaurant, which is done out in a charming minimalist style....
